evidence.title: Japan National Tourism Organization — regions and prefectures
evidence.inspected_fact: Fetched destination taxonomy explicitly lists all 47 prefectures under Hokkaido, Tohoku, Hokuriku Shinetsu, Kanto, Tokai, Kansai, Chugoku, Shikoku, Kyushu and Okinawa. These are adopted geographic/functional blocs, not historical jurisdictions or country ownership.

evidence.title: Pinned geoBoundaries Japan prefecture source
evidence.inspected_fact: Inspected all 47 actual shapeName/shapeID prefecture features; the current atlas has 62 province groups representing those same 47 names. Reference source vintage is 2017, ODbL 1.0. Representative-point containment checked for all 1,688 locations: Tajiri and Ashiya are two coastal mismatch diagnostics left open.

evidence.title: State Statistical Committee of Azerbaijan — Regionlar
evidence.inspected_fact: Fetched current official page, updated 29 June 2026, lists the fourteen named economic regions and district/city members. Mainland districts are grouped into thirteen named functional regions; Nakhchivan is retained separately. Geographic grouping never assigns a polity or imports the listed modern socioeconomic values.

evidence.title: Pinned Azerbaijan district/city territories
evidence.inspected_fact: Inspected all 79 source features and IDs; role District, source vintage 2020. evidence.title: Johnston Atoll National Wildlife Refuge
evidence.inspected_fact: The inspected FWS page says Johnston is one of the most isolated atolls, 716 nautical miles southwest of Honolulu; it is a separately named atoll, not a Hawaiian island-chain county.

evidence.title: IBGE Brasília membership record
evidence.inspected_fact: Municipality Brasília 5300108 → immediate region Distrito Federal 530001 → intermediate region Distrito Federal 5301 → UF Distrito Federal 53. The current sole location is the same named Brasília source territory.

evidence.title: IBGE UF registry
evidence.inspected_fact: Inspected all 27 UFs; Distrito Federal is UF 53. All other Brazilian state areas already exist, but this area is absent.
